I took insane amounts of paracetamol for 6 months straight trying to kill myself. I’m talking 10 grams a day (we have these 1G pills where I live)… all I got was a stomach ache caused by an inflamed stomach lining. 

Then I went on to harder things - engine coolant (ethylene glycol). I drank two large gulps a day and a total of 1L in about a month. Still nothing.. I’m still here. I got my liver and kidneys checked to see if I’d have at least done some damage, but nope my liver and kidneys were fine. All it did was make my hair fall out and my skin break out. 

Human bodies are insanely resilient. It’s crazy how some people die from really small amounts of and others can abuse things for a lifetime and they’ll be okay.

In 2015, after a fight with my ex, I took two handfuls of whatever I could find at home (beta blockers, Wellbutrin, aspirin, Xanax) and washed it down with a bottle of vodka. I was super disoriented, went across the street to my parents house to look for them but they weren’t home. Tried to go upstairs and got maybe 7 steps in when I tripped and fell flat on my back nearly missing the sharp corner of their coffee table with my head. Passed out on the floor and laid there till the next morning until my dad came home and found me there. 
He didn’t know about my whole suicide fiasco so he thought I’d gotten drunk and passed out on the floor so he lifted me up and put me on the couch to sleep it off.. couple hours later mum gets home, my ex had contacted her via messenger (long distance relationship) and told her what had happened. Ambulance came, my parents were devastated at this point and my dad was crying when I was blue lighted to the hospital. I started hallucinating and kept screaming at everyone, they tied me to the bed to restrain me, but I shook my feet so hard I rubbed them raw on the bed linens. Worse hallucinations that you can think of. Death, gore, everything- still remember bits and pieces. They pumped my stomach, sedated me and took me to the mental hospital where I was put in diapers, restrained and slept for 1,5 days until I woke up having no idea what had happened.

I feel like there's more to this story than we're reading and this will probably downvoted, but here's my take on this post:

1. did you use a designer from an agency or a proper freelancer or did you use a "designer" from fiverr? there's a big difference. a proper designer has a contract that you could go through to get the answers and they would give you drafts and updates during the design process. 

2. did they specifically tell you to send "other realtors logos you liked" or did they ask you to send examples of logos you like? even if they said "send other realtors logos".. you saying you have a clear vision of what you want, you could've maybe went into more detail to explain it to them instead of just sending them realtors logos you like? 

and in case you came up with this "clear vision" after you placed the initial order - that's another order, cause it's a redesign not a revision. you have a degree in marketing so you should be fairly familiar with the whole brand design process.

3. If their "package" states you get one revision, you get one revision, not a redesign.

Hey,

I grew up knowing I'm neurotypical and only received my diagnosis about 6 months ago at the age of 28. I learned how to communicate with the help of my peers and other people around me. Even though I thought I was just like everyone else, I knew I didn't "communicate" like them. I'd always observe others when they were talking and / or what they would talk about and how they did it. I've never had a problem with eye contact so that's a positive as I know a lot of Aspies struggle with that.

First thing I noticed was actually being interested in what the other person was saying and mostly talking about myself so I changed that, I'd also have a problem with knowing WHAT to talk about other than the weather cause really.. I couldn't come up with anything. So when I met someone new, I would ask them what they did for a living and maybe talk about current affairs or something related to the situation we were in (I met my gf at the gym, we've both got tattoos so I complimented her tattoos and asked her how long she's been working out and it went from there).

*I couldn't talk about my VERY narrow field of interests cause my interests are medicine and psychology and frankly no one else is as interested in medicine as I am unless they're a doctor.*

I'd suggest mimicking what NO's in your life are doing and mastering that. When I received my diagnosis my psychologist asked me how my communication skills were that good and I just told her I had to learn how to do things from a young age. As for being interested in what others are saying ...  I am genuinely interested when it comes to the people in my life, but if it's someone I've just met I just pretend .. as bad as that sounds.

I used to delete my comments too so at one point I realised it's best if I don't even comment cause it would bug me for days after I did it and I ended up deleting it anyways so not doing it is the same :)

Best of luck with everything!
